coverageStatus: All text in the reviewed Otzaria edited source. Its 139 responsum headings run from 1 to 140 but omit the heading for 138; that numbering/content gap remains unresolved and this is not claimed to be the complete historical work. The edited source restores the passage and responsa 28–29 lost where direct Dicta files 36 and 37 repeat. Existing digital text, sampled for coherence rather than proofread word by word. No English translation is included.
identityReview: The edited source identifies Maharam of Lublin, begins with responsa on personal-status law, preserves the author's signatures and ends at responsum 140. It is distinct from Maharam's Talmud commentary and the responsa of Meir of Rothenburg. This edited source restores the duplicated-page region in the direct Dicta text.
qualityReview: Checked UTF-8, control/replacement characters, allowed heading/bold markup, ordered responsum headings, substantial duplicated sections and first/middle/final text samples. Verified the repaired boundary leading into responsa 28–29. Numbering skips 138 in both the edited source and the inspected direct source; this unresolved gap is disclosed. Original source markup is bundled unchanged; no OCR, translation or invented text by Amudi.
sourceProduction: Existing provider text; no OCR or new translation performed by Amudi.
